lookup_work_case_change_request.returns: NONE, REPLAY with original 200 envelope, or ERROR

submit_work_case_change.returns: ACCEPTED or REPLAY with http_status=200 and response={data:{case_id,...},meta:{request_id}}, or ERROR
transaction: Use service-role only and bind receipts to authenticated owner, operation, case and canonical body hash. Replay before mutable case guards. A conflicting hash or in-flight receipt returns 409.

Lock the owned case, or return 404 for missing or foreign case. Verify expected_revision before validating the requested plan. For DECISION require an unarchived Complete/REVIEW_READY case, a current card whose input_revision and review_revision match, and no final decision.
SELECT_PLAN must resolve a VALID plan on that card or return 422 INVALID_PLAN_SELECTION. Read plan fields and total from storage. Persist decision, selected_plan_id and selected_plan_jsonb together.
HOLD saves decision and note as a human judgment. Do not set processing_step=ON_HOLD for this judgment. Clear any previously selected plan atomically.
CONFIRM_REVIEW saves the decision and archived_at together with the log. Reuse a selected plan only when its stored input revision, card revision and VALID plan identity all match the current card.
ARCHIVE permits Waiting, Pending or Complete and checks for conflicting work or outbound leases. RESTORE requires archived_at and clears it without starting a new job or reopening a final judgment.
Commit the change, workflow log and original response receipt atomically.
